title: eludite/project/addItem
description: Add a new item to a project from an item template (Add > New Item..., brief 0072; host-rpc.md, "Templates and items"). The namespace is the project's `RootNamespace` (else its file name) plus the folder's path below the project, each segment made an identifier. Eludite's built-in templates (`eludite.*` identities) write the file themselves with that namespace; any other runs `dotnet new <shortName> --name <name> --output <folder> --project <project>`. A legacy (explicit-include) project gets a `Compile` item per new `.cs`/`.vb`/`.fs` file and a `Content` item per other file, with the construction model preserving formatting, and the solution reloads (a new generation); an SDK project is not written. A file that exists is refused.

folder.description: The folder the item goes in (absolute; the project's folder or below it).

template.description: The template's identity or short name.

name.description: The item's name, with or without its extension (`Customer` or `Customer.cs`).

files.description: The files created, absolute; the first is the one to open.

projectWritten.description: True when the project file gained items.

generation.description: The solution generation after the change.
